/.title: Online Counselling & Therapy | Vive Counselling
/.description: Online counselling for individuals and couples across Australia. Support with anxiety, depression and relationships. Kink, ENM and LGBTQIA+ inclusive.

/working-with-joel.title: Joel Griffiths, Psychodynamic Counsellor | Vive Counselling
/working-with-joel.description: Meet Joel Griffiths, an ACA-registered counsellor based in Perth and working online across Australia. Learn about his approach to therapy.

/inclusive-counselling.title: Kink, ENM and LGBTQIA+ Inclusive Counselling | Vive Counselling
/inclusive-counselling.description: Online counselling across Australia with an understanding of kink, ENM and LGBTQIA+ lives. You can talk openly about your mental health and relationships.

/kink-bdsm-counselling.title: Kink & BDSM-Aware Counselling | Vive Counselling
/kink-bdsm-counselling.description: Online kink-aware therapy across Australia with a counsellor who understands BDSM. Talk about kink, relationships or whatever brings you to counselling.

/polyamory-enm-counselling.title: Polyamory & Open Relationship Counselling | Vive Counselling
/polyamory-enm-counselling.description: Online counselling for polyamory and ENM across Australia. Support with jealousy, agreements and change, without assuming monogamy is the answer.

/lgbtqia-affirming-counselling.title: LGBTQIA+ Affirming Counselling | Vive Counselling
/lgbtqia-affirming-counselling.description: LGBTQIA+ affirming online counselling across Australia. Talk about anxiety, relationships, sexuality or gender without having to justify who you are.

/articles.title: Psychology and Counselling Articles | Vive Counselling
/articles.description: In-depth articles on mental health, relationships and sexuality, examining the research on why we struggle and how therapy can help.

/contact.title: Counselling Fees & Contact | Vive Counselling
/contact.description: 50-minute online counselling sessions at $120 for individuals and $150 for couples. Ask a question or request a free 15-minute consultation with Joel.

/crisis-support.title: Crisis Support Numbers in Australia | Vive Counselling
/crisis-support.description: Call 000 for immediate danger. Find 24/7 Australian crisis lines and state or territory urgent mental health services, with official contact details.

/privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy | Vive Counselling
/privacy-policy.description: How Vive Counselling handles personal information from website visits, enquiries and counselling, including access, correction and privacy complaints.
